Market and state names, tags and section order live here; school facts (class cap, tuition) come from esa-landing.json, proof numbers from family-survey.json and student-results.json, reviews from reviews.json, accreditation copy from Akis (2026-11-19), logos from thebinaschool.com. _openQuestions: Pricing: thebinaschool.com shows tuition only on routes the operator (Ihor Kosse) approved. These pages show USD + local currency. Get his OK before the pages move to the main site.
Tally intake form says $898/month; thebinaschool.com/tuition says $897/month (yearly plan). One of them is wrong.
The Ontario homeschooling guide (/homeschooling-guides/ontario) is built on the main-site stage but not live yet. The Toronto guide link 404s until it is.
Toronto hero facts: '6-12 kids' per class (Akis, 2026-11-19) vs 'average class of six to eight, never more than 12' (esa-landing.json). Both hold; keep them aligned if either changes.
Cal.com events sync (team 243242, slugs local-{market}-…) is not wired here: events are hand-kept in local-events.json until the pages move to the main site, which has the sync script.

cards.title: 11 subjects at every grade
items: Social Studies: history, geography, civics, economics

cards.title: Taught by theme, not in silos
cards.text: The year runs through 8 biomes: Freshwater, Desert, Tundra, Grasslands, Rainforest, Marine, Microbiome and Forest. Each one ties the subjects to a single theme, and skills come back deeper in the next.

cards.title: Life skills are a real subject
cards.text: At 7, children plan a spend-save-share budget. At 11, they learn to spot scams. At 13, they budget for independent living.

cards.title: Live, in a small group
cards.text: Live classes with the same small group and the same teachers: an average of six to eight children with two teachers in the room, never more than {classCap}.

cards.title: A real school day
cards.text: 9am–2pm Eastern, Monday to Friday: live classes, adventures, clubs and passion projects, about 200 days a year.

cards.title: Skills come back, deeper
cards.text: Each topic is taught at the earliest grade any of bina's reference curricula teaches it, then revisited at greater depth in later biomes.

cards.title: You see where your child stands
cards.text: Weekly snapshots of what they have mastered and what comes next, plus STAR assessments twice a year.
